args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
Fixes the nightly build failure: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`. Changed the rounding mode in `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so `2.675 -> 2.68` and `2.665 -> 2.66`.

CI run ci-0001 on commit 08d3cd5986: passed.

Please review, @alex.
